metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz replays the validated two-hand Sharpa Wave authoring trajectory (854 controls, success after 754, 100 hold rows of slack) produced by a closed-loop scripted controller that only chooses motor targets; it passes two fresh-process replays with identical state hashes and also succeeds with float32-rounded rows. The standard oracle submits the same rows as float64 through the public client.

notes.layout: Two hands of the chosen model are used: each row starts with the right wrist stage (6 targets) and the left wrist stage (6 targets), then the right hand's finger targets and the left hand's finger targets (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`). The left Sharpa Wave is the right model reflected in y; the left Wuji Hand 2.2 is the manufacturer's left model.
